V1.verbatim: To compare the two versions of Bing, one option is to do a controlled experiment, which is also known as an A/B test. Each person in the experiment is assigned either to a control group that sees system A or a treatment group that sees system B.
V1.onde: Doc 4, blog 'Experimentation and Continuous Improvement at Bing', seção 'Using Online Evaluation'
V1.por_que: Nomeia explicitamente experimento controlado, teste A/B e grupos de controle/tratamento — nível 3 da escada, em registro de blog (não-vinculante).

V1.verbatim: As a Bing user, you have probably taken part in both A/B and paired evaluations many times.
V1.onde: Doc 4, parágrafo final antes das referências
V1.por_que: Afirma diretamente que usuários são incluídos em experimentos A/B, reforçando nível 3 fora do contrato.

V1.verbatim: What is an online controlled experiment? In its simplest form, called an A/B test , we randomly split our users into two groups as shown in the diagram below. Their experiences are exactly the same, except for a change introduced to the Treatment (or B group).
V1.onde: Doc 5, blog 'Large Scale Experimentation at Bing', corpo
V1.por_que: Randomização explícita de usuários em grupos — teto 3 inequívoco, registro não-vinculante.

V1.verbatim: Almost every user is in some experiment when they visit Bing. In fact, almost every user is in about 15 different experiments. There is no single Bing any more, but rather each user falls into one of the 30B possible experiment combinations.
V1.onde: Doc 5, lista de pontos do paper KDD
V1.por_que: Quantifica participação universal dos usuários em experimentos; evidência máxima de nível 3 em registro não-vinculante.

V1.verbatim: We continuously work to improve the Services and may change the Services or delete features or stop providing access to Third-Party Apps and Services in that respect at any time
V1.por_que: No registro vinculante só aparece linguagem de 'melhorar o serviço' — sustenta nível 1 para o binding isolado.

V1.verbatim: To the extent necessary to provide the Services to you and others (which may include changing the size, shape or format of Your Content to better store or display it to you), to protect you and the Services and to improve Microsoft products and services, you grant Microsoft a worldwide and royalty free intellectual property licence to use Your Content
V1.por_que: Outra cláusula vinculante de 'improve products and services' sem menção a teste ou experimento.

V1.verbatim: Product improvement . We use data to improve our products, including adding new features and capabilities. For example, we use error reports to improve security features, queries and clicks in Bing to improve search results, and voice data to develop and improve speech recognition accuracy.
V1.onde: Doc 2 (Privacy Statement), seção 'How we use personal data' > 'Product Improvement and Development'
V1.por_que: Registro de privacidade permanece em linguagem de melhoria, sem nomear teste/experimento — relevante para o nível do registro vinculante/privacidade.

V1.verbatim: Our researchers often recruit users to try out new features and give us their opinions. Once they’re satisfied, we release the feature to a small set of real users to see how they interact with it.
V1.onde: Doc 6 ('How Bing delivers search results', marcado non-binding), seção 'Improving Search Results' > 'Research and Testing'
V1.por_que: Reconhece testar com usuários reais sem nomear A/B ou randomização — nível 2 neste documento; útil para avaliar o teto por registro.

V1.verbatim: The metrics are used for new feature evaluation as a part of Responsible AI reviews as well as ongoing monitoring for features post launch.
V1.por_que: Avaliação de features com usuários pós-lançamento, sem método experimental nomeado — apoia leitura de nível 2 no help centre.

V2.verbatim: To the extent necessary to provide the Services to you and others (which may include changing the size, shape or format of Your Content to better store or display it to you), to protect you and the Services and to improve Microsoft products and services
V2.por_que: Enquadramento de service improvement no registro vinculante.

V2.verbatim: Improve and develop our products. As part of our efforts to improve and develop our products, we may use your data to develop and train our AI models.
V2.onde: Doc 2, seção 'How we use personal data' (resumo)
V2.por_que: Service improvement explícito no Privacy Statement.

V2.verbatim: Research . With appropriate safeguards for individuals’ rights and freedoms, we use data for research, including AI and machine learning, for public interest and scientific purposes.
V2.onde: Doc 2, seção 'How we use personal data' > 'Business Operations'
V2.por_que: Enquadramento de research (inclusive 'public interest and scientific purposes') no registro de privacidade.

V2.verbatim: As members of a research team at Bing, we get to work on a large range of interesting problems in machine learning, data mining and information retrieval.
V2.por_que: Enquadramento de pesquisa científica (equipe de research, paper em conferência).

V2.verbatim: Our WSDM-2013 paper [ 4 ] proposes a new way of performing unbiased and informative paired evaluations.
V2.por_que: Reforça enquadramento research (publicação acadêmica sobre experimentos com usuários).

V2.verbatim: Ronny’s blog is a brief summary of a research paper titled Online Controlled Experiments at Large Scale which will he will present next week at the international conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining ( KDD 2013 ).
V2.onde: Doc 5, introdução assinada por Harry Shum
V2.por_que: Enquadramento de pesquisa acadêmica associado diretamente aos experimentos com usuários.

V2.verbatim: The idea is to expose our changes to real users and see if their experiences improve
V2.por_que: Co-ocorrência de service improvement com research no mesmo documento.

V2.verbatim: Search engines like Bing play a vital role in upholding the fundamental right to free and open access to information and free expression, and we strive to help users find the most useful and relevant information that they seek.
V2.por_que: Linguagem de bem público/direitos fundamentais — candidata a social-good, embora não atrelada explicitamente a experimentos.

V2.verbatim: We take steps to protect users from harmful and unexpected offensive content.
V2.por_que: Enquadramento de proteção/segurança da comunidade, possivelmente codificável como social-good; avaliador decide se atrelado à experimentação.

V3.verbatim: A real example of an A/B test is as follows. We wanted to add a feature allowing advertisers to provide links to the target site.
V3.por_que: V3c: divulga um experimento específico (site links em anúncios), com layout de anúncios como superfície testada.

V3.verbatim: Ads with site link experiment. Treatment (bottom) has site links. The difference might not be obvious at first but it is worth tens of millions of dollars
V3.por_que: Experimento específico nomeado e quantificado — sustenta V3a e V3c.

V3.verbatim: In this experiment, the evaluation criterion was simple: increase average revenue per user without degrading key user engagement metrics.
V3.por_que: Alvo do experimento: receita por usuário e engajamento — relevante para V3b (e para julgar se preço/monetização está em jogo).

V3.verbatim: Even after reducing the extra space consumed by the new feature by lowering the average number of ads shown per query, this feature improved revenue by tens of millions of dollars per year with neutral user impact
V3.por_que: Detalha manipulação de densidade de anúncios (fricção/layout) como alvo experimental.

V3.verbatim: On a typical day, there are over 250 experiments running on Bing.
V3.por_que: Indica experimentos ativos no momento da publicação — relevante para V3c (específico/ativo).

V3.verbatim: Our powerful machine learning systems correct the spelling of your query , interpret your search intent, differentiate quality pages from junk , rank documents from our index of tens of billions of documents, and optimize whole-page layout .
V3.por_que: V3a/V3b: nomeia ranking e layout de página como sistemas otimizados por medição de usuários.

V3.verbatim: A typical online experiment compares some new version of Bing to the existing version, to see whether the new idea is an improvement on average.
V3.por_que: Atividade testada = versões do produto; base para V3a.

V3.verbatim: For example, if the selected result is at rank 4 in A and rank 2 in B, perhaps this gives 2 points to B, rewarding based on the difference in rank.
V3.onde: Doc 4, descrição da função de recompensa
V3.por_que: Ranking explicitamente manipulado entre variantes — alvo de experimento (V3b).

V3.verbatim: Before users ever see an improvement or new feature at Bing, we’ve been hard at work behind the scenes.
V3.por_que: Atividades testadas descritas genericamente como features (V3a) no help centre.

V3.verbatim: Microsoft may change the rates for calling phones and premium rate numbers, as well as calling destinations, that are not part of a subscription.
V3.por_que: Menção a mudança de preços contratual — NÃO é alvo de experimento de preço; incluída para o avaliador descartar falso positivo em V3-pricing.

V3.verbatim: we may change the price of the Services if we change, add new or improve Service features, to the extent the costs of providing the Service have changed accordingly, or in response to market changes
V3.por_que: Cláusula de alteração de preço sem qualquer indicação de teste/variação entre usuários — relevante para decidir V3-pricing como No.

V4.verbatim: We process your personal data with your consent and/or when it’s necessary to provide the products you use, operate our business, meet our contractual and legal obligations, protect the security and safety of our systems and our customers, or pursue our legitimate interests or those of third parties.
V4.onde: Doc 2, seção 'How we use personal data' > 'Legal bases for processing'
V4.por_que: Enumera bases legais (consentimento, contrato, obrigação legal, interesse legítimo) de forma genérica, sem atribuir base específica a experimentação.

V4.verbatim: Our legal basis for processing may vary depending on how and across what products or services we process your data. When we rely on legitimate interests, we consider and balance those interests against your rights and freedoms and will only process your data if these interests are not outweighed by your own.
V4.por_que: Confirma ausência de tabela base-por-finalidade; base para experimentação teria de ser inferida da cláusula de melhoria.

V4.verbatim: Product improvement . We use data to improve our products, including adding new features and capabilities. For example, we use error reports to improve security features, queries and clicks in Bing to improve search results
V4.por_que: É a finalidade declarada que mais plausivelmente cobre experimentação (queries e cliques no Bing para melhorar resultados).

V4.verbatim: Research . With appropriate safeguards for individuals’ rights and freedoms, we use data for research, including AI and machine learning, for public interest and scientific purposes.
V4.por_que: Segunda finalidade candidata a cobrir experimentação; 'safeguards' sugere interesse legítimo/interesse público sem nomear a base.

V4.verbatim: Microsoft receives and responds to the Global Privacy Control (GPC) browser opt-out signal in certain jurisdictions.
V4.por_que: Exemplo de gating por jurisdição para publicidade — relevante para avaliar v4_region_gated (aplicado a ads, não a experimentação).

V4.verbatim: The laws of Ireland govern all claims related to cost-free and paid Services, but this shall not deprive you of the mandatory consumer protections under the law of the country to which we direct your Services where you have your habitual residence
V4.por_que: Mostra estrutura jurisdicional do contrato (entidade irlandesa para UE/UK), útil para julgar region-gating documental.

V5.verbatim: You can also object to or restrict the use of your personal data by Microsoft. For example, you can object at any time to our use of your personal data for direct marketing purposes or where we are performing a task in the public interest or pursuing our legitimate interests or those of a third party.
V5.onde: Doc 2, 'How to access and control your personal data'
V5.por_que: Direito genérico de objeção (Art. 21-like), sem controle específico de experimentação — candidato a GDPR-objection-only.

V5.verbatim: Where required, we obtain your consent prior to placing or using optional cookies that are not (i) strictly necessary to provide the website or service; or (ii) for the purpose of facilitating a communication.
V5.por_que: Consentimento de cookies rege publicidade/analytics, não experimentação — falso positivo a descartar.

V5.verbatim: To opt out of receiving personalised advertising from Microsoft (including Xandr) visit our Personalised ads and offers page .
V5.por_que: Opt-out existente é de anúncios personalizados, não de experimentos — evidência de cookie/ads-only.

V5.verbatim: Bing. If you are signed into Bing with your Microsoft account, you can view and clear your stored search and chat history on your privacy dashboard . If you are not signed in, you can view and clear stored search history associated with your device in your Bing settings .
V5.onde: Doc 2, lista de ferramentas de controle
V5.por_que: Controle disponível para Bing é histórico de busca, não participação em experimentos — mostra ausência de opt-out dedicado.

V5.verbatim: Users can update their location, language, and other settings via Bing Settings , and delete search history on the Privacy Dashboard .
V5.por_que: Controles de Bing enumerados não incluem opt-out de experimentação.

V5.verbatim: You may turn on and off autosuggest feature in the Bing Setting page ( Search - Settings (bing.com)) by selecting or unselecting the “See search suggestions as you type” checkbox.
V5.por_que: Controle de feature específica (sugestões), não de participação em testes — avaliador deve verificar que não constitui opt-out de experimento.

V5.verbatim: Almost every user is in some experiment when they visit Bing.
V5.por_que: Participação universal declarada sem qualquer menção a mecanismo de recusa, reforçando ausência de opt-out dedicado.

V6.verbatim: Support may not be available for preview or beta versions of features or Services.
V6.por_que: Reconhece existência de versões preview/beta, mas sem descrever inscrição voluntária.

V6.verbatim: Microsoft offers preview, insider, beta or other free-of-charge products and features ("previews") to enable you to evaluate them while providing data about your use of the product, including feedback and device and usage data.
V6.por_que: Descreve programa de previews/insider em que o usuário opta por avaliar features antecipadamente — evidência central para V6.

V6.verbatim: Data about the operating system and its configuration such as the OS version and build number, region and language settings, diagnostics data settings, and whether the device is part of the Windows Insider Programme.
V6.por_que: Confirma existência do Windows Insider Programme como canal de participação voluntária.

V6.verbatim: Our researchers often recruit users to try out new features and give us their opinions.
V6.por_que: Recrutamento de usuários para testar features; avaliador decide se equivale a canal beta opt-in para Bing.

V7.verbatim: Ideally you would not even know that you are in an experiment.
V7.por_que: Declaração explícita de que o desejável é o usuário não saber que participa — nega frontalmente qualquer debriefing; 'No' substantivo.

V7.verbatim: It is a blind experiment, meaning that you can’t tell which came from Bing today, and which came from our new idea.
V7.por_que: Cegamento declarado, sem menção a aviso posterior.

V7.verbatim: Since there is no questionnaire, the main thing we can observe is your search behavior:
V7.por_que: Confirma ausência de qualquer interação informativa com o participante.

V7.verbatim: We'll inform you of the intended change before it takes effect, either through the user interface, in an email message or through other reasonable means.
V7.por_que: Aviso de mudança de termos/serviço — falso positivo explicitamente excluído pelo critério; incluído para o avaliador descartar.

V7.verbatim: Communications . We may use your data to contact you for various reasons, such as to inform you about your subscriptions, tell you when product updates are available, or contact you about your account.
V7.por_que: Comunicações previstas são de serviço/conta, não debriefing experimental.

V8.verbatim: Bing's generative AI experiences has been developed in line with Microsoft’s AI Principles , Microsoft’s Responsible AI Standard , and in partnership with responsible AI experts across the company, including Microsoft’s Office of Responsible AI, our engineering teams, Microsoft Research, and Aether.
V8.por_que: Menciona órgão de revisão interno (Office of Responsible AI, Aether) e padrão de IA responsável — candidato forte a Yes, embora referido a features de IA, não a experimentos A/B.

V8.verbatim: The metrics are used for new feature evaluation as a part of Responsible AI reviews as well as ongoing monitoring for features post launch.
V8.por_que: Descreve revisão formal (Responsible AI reviews) aplicada a avaliação de novas features — aproxima-se de revisão ética/risco de experimentos.

V8.verbatim: Guided by our AI Principles and our Responsible AI Standard, we sought to identify, measure, and mitigate potential risks while securing the transformative and beneficial uses that the new experience provides.
V8.por_que: Avaliação de risco explícita em documento ao usuário (registro não-vinculante).

V8.verbatim: These features are designed, built and tested in accordance of Microsoft Responsible AI standard.
V8.por_que: Liga teste de features a um padrão de revisão responsável.

V8.verbatim: Statistical tests are run regularly to detect badly performing experiments and interacting experiments; alerts are e-mailed to the experiment owners for underperforming experiments, and those impacting key metrics more severely are shut down automatically.
V8.por_que: Controle de risco de experimentos, porém métrico/operacional e não ético — avaliador decide se conta.

V8.verbatim: To make decisions or take actions without appropriate human oversight that may have a consequential impact on any person’s legal position, financial position, life opportunities, employment opportunities or human rights
V8.por_que: Linguagem de 'impacto' e supervisão humana, mas dirigida a restrições de uso do usuário, não a revisão ética de experimentos — borderline a marcar No com nota.

How Bing delivers search results
